purpose: Hidden expectation key for the known-answer web fixtures. Never open this file during an audit of the fixtures; list this directory as a forbidden input in every blind manifest.

WF-A-01.planted: The category control is labeled as a filter but sorts the grid by name; no card is ever removed.
WF-A-01.detectable_by: Operating the select and observing that all six cards remain visible in changed order.

WF-A-02.detectable_by: The search input hides non-matching cards as typed; it behaves as labeled.

WF-A-03.planted: View tabs swap content with no address; Share copies the bare URL, so a shared planting-calendar view opens the default catalogue. Returning to Catalogue reloads the page.
WF-A-03.detectable_by: Switching views, observing an unchanged URL, and operating Share.

WF-A-04.detectable_by: The repeated card grid is a consistent system primitive; repetition alone is not slop.

WF-B-01.planted: Unsupported superlatives and audience-free filler: most advanced, 10,000 industry leaders with no source, revolutionize, unparalleled, unlock full potential.
WF-B-01.detectable_by: No claim in the block is checkable; every sentence survives transplant to any product.

WF-B-02.detectable_by: Each claim is concrete and checkable: price, cancellation, transfer time, CSV export, reminder policy, linked uptime record.

WF-B-03.planted: Synthetic proof: five-star rating citing no source or count, an unattributed Best Invoicing Tool 2026 award, a Certified Excellence badge certifying nothing, and a bank-grade security claim with no named control.
WF-B-03.detectable_by: No badge resolves to a verifiable source anywhere on the page.

WF-B-04.detectable_by: The interface imagery is explicitly captioned as a product demonstration with simulated data; provenance is honest.

WF-C-01.planted: Placeholder-only inputs with no labels; helper text at roughly 2.8:1 contrast (#999999 on #f5f5f5), below the WCAG 1.4.3 minimum of 4.5:1; Apply defaults is a span with no keyboard path, no focus state, and no effect.
WF-C-01.detectable_by: Keyboard traversal skips the span; computed contrast fails; inputs have no accessible name.

WF-C-02.detectable_by: Visible labels bound with for/id, autocomplete tokens, a real button with a visible focus style, and a role=status confirmation.

WF-C-03.planted: Save changes gives no feedback and clears the field; the value is silently discarded.
WF-C-03.detectable_by: Typing a note, activating Save, and observing the field empty with no confirmation and no persisted state.

WF-C-04.detectable_by: The toggle updates aria-pressed and mirrors its state in visible text; it behaves as promised.
